Text: $SMH and $SOXX both provide semiconductor exposure, but they are not identical. 🔹 $SMH is more concentrated in the industry’s largest global leaders. Its heavier exposure to companies like $NVDA and $TSM can provide greater upside, but also creates more concentration risk. 🔹 $SOXX holds more companies and distributes its exposure more evenly, offering slightly better diversification at a marginally lower expense ratio. My simple view: $SMH = more concentrated growth $SOXX = more balanced semiconductor exposure Both can benefit from AI and rising chip demand, but both remain highly volatile. Which one do you prefer? 📈
